summary: CD-0171 D2's sentence naming the Project description for the Initiative narrative reads instead: the narrative becomes the Project content, and the description holds only legacy text a pre-import Project carried. The shipped Linear client and narrative-revision sync already send content. Amends CD-0171 D2 at that sentence only; every other D2 sentence and D1 and D3 through D6 stand unchanged.
title: CD-0171 D2 maps the Initiative narrative to Project content
